question: A block of mass $m_1$ rests on an incline of angle $\theta = 20^\circ$. The coefficients of static and kinetic friction are $\mu_s = 0.8$ and $\mu_k = 0.5$. It is connected via a massless string over a massless and frictionless pulley. Block $m_2$ has mass 2 kg. If $m_1 = 1.5$kg, what's the magnitude of the acceleration of the $m_2$ (in $m/s^2$)?
title: InclinedPlaneAccelerationCalculation
